adjudication.rationale: The server input schema in `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts` validates `guests` as `z.array(z.string().email())` but does not enforce uniqueness. In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` only filters out emails already present in `booking.attendees` and blacklisted emails; it does not deduplicate duplicates within the incoming `guests` array. As a result, direct API calls can pass `guests: ["a@x.com","a@x.com"]`, and `attendees.createMany` will attempt to insert duplicate attendee rows / trigger duplicate notification behavior.
